output.summary: Central IT does not deprioritise Arts as Arts: Arts non-SlotBook tickets match other faculties' same-category medians within 0.3 days. About 70% of the Arts resolution gap comes from RR-17 routing SlotBook tickets to the P4 best-effort queue, which has 0.4 FTE and no target, and the acknowledgement template hides this from requesters. Most of the residual gap comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site coverage at Lindqvist. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 is unresolved: the meeting is recorded but its content is not. Recommend a written SlotBook support agreement and an accurate acknowledgement now. Hold the CampusBook migration and the 2 FTE transfer until fit and capacity are tested, and reject demoting all Arts tickets.
